VISUAL FLOWCHART FACT12 shows E2. Is the freeze sensor loose or off the coil? Replace the freeze sensor and retest. Reseat the freeze sensor on the evaporator coil. Is the code still present? Replace the freeze sensor and retest. The code cleared. That is the correction. YES NO NO YES BAY PROCEDURE Bay order · Tacoma RV Center WHAT THIS PATTERN USUALLY MEANS A FACT12 E2 is a freeze-sensor seating fault. Check the freeze sensor on the evaporator coil before any board swap. If it is loose or off the coil, reseat it and retest. BAY ORDER (DO THIS FIRST) 1. On a FACT12 E2, find the freeze sensor on the evaporator coil. If it is loose or off the coil, reseat it and retest. If it is already seated, go to the replace step. 2. Reseat the freeze sensor on the evaporator coil. If the code clears, that is the confirmed correction. 3. If the sensor is seated and the code remains, replace the freeze sensor and retest. DO NOT - Do not replace the control board before the freeze sensor is reseated. SOURCES (SHOP DOCUMENT LIBRARY) - Furrion Chill FACR08 8K manual CCD-0008666 page 5
